notes: Readiness % is deterministic. Tiers never gate actions. Copy is terse UI-facing; CTA drives the next concrete step.

tiers.label: Cold
tiers.microcopy: Big gap. Pick one target skill and prove it.
tiers.cv_hint: CV will be Starter. Proof will upgrade it.

tiers.label: Warming
tiers.microcopy: Some overlap. Proof on primary skills moves the needle fastest.
tiers.cv_hint: One proof artifact flips CV to Proof-backed.

tiers.label: Competitive
tiers.microcopy: Close. Proof on missing primary skills closes it.
tiers.cv_hint: CV is Proof-backed. Three proofs unlock Strong evidence.

tiers.label: Strong
tiers.cv_hint: CV is Strong evidence. Ship it.
